label: ICSH membership
title: ICSH Membership — A Place for Everyone
paragraphs: Join the ICSH community with flexible annual membership options designed to make membership accessible to more people.
Membership lasts 12 months from confirmed membership fee payment, or confirmed activation for free membership.
Explore the membership options below and use fictional details to test the application form.
Everyone is welcome, whether you are joining for the first time or renewing. Minors aged 16 and below are eligible for FREE membership; joining and renewal forms accept ages 17 and above only.

Submit Test Application saves fictional details for ICSH organiser review and shows a reference after the website confirms the save. Bigin delivery requires separate organiser action. No membership is activated, payment taken or email sent.
